# Kahn1

> Kahn1 is an open-source "System 1" decision engine in two sizes: Kahn1 4B (Qwen3.5-4B + LoRA) and Kahn1 3B (Qwen2.5-3B + LoRA), both running on a GPU (vLLM) or a CPU (transformers). The 3B is smaller and faster; the 4B is much stronger on hard judgment calls. It takes a text (the state) and typed questions (Choice, Score, Noul) and returns, for each question, a typed value and a calibrated probability distribution read from the logits of the option tokens. It generates no text, so schema errors cannot happen. Code MIT; Kahn1 4B weights Apache 2.0; Kahn1 3B weights under the Qwen Research License of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, a research licence (see its terms: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct/blob/main/LICENSE). By Axel Montzamir.

Key results (14,663 held-out items, k = 3 permutations, temperature calibration, one RTX 5070 Ti with vLLM; Choice asked over 8 options, the right one and 7 seeded distractors). Kahn1 4B: 70.3% overall, ECE 0.064; Choice 91.9% (banking77 91.5%, MASSIVE 92.4%); Score 48.6% exact on 5-level scales; Noul 72.2% (RTE 86.6%, SciTail 70.4%); median latency 87.5 ms, p95 204.8 ms, 9.3 queries/s. Kahn1 3B: 70.3% overall, ECE 0.082; Choice 90.9%, Score 51.4% (SST-5 95.2% within one level), Noul 67.0%; median latency 36.4 ms. External JevBench, 231 public items: Kahn1 4B 83.1% (easy 100%, original 91.7%, hard 70.3%), Kahn1 3B 67.5% (hard 42.3%). Hard decision dev split (317 questions on long documents, English and French): base Qwen3.5-4B 48.9%, Kahn1 4B 62.1%.

Kahn1 vs JEV 1.13.0 (TypeSafe API), like for like. On the 14,663 Kahn1 held-out items, same prompts and the same 8 options on Choice, JEV run through its API: JEV 73.2%, Kahn1 4B 70.3%, Kahn1 3B 70.3%; JEV is ahead on every primitive (Choice 94.5% vs 91.9% for the 4B, Score 52.0% vs 48.6%, Noul 74.4% vs 72.2%, JEV asked whether the text supports the statement); ECE JEV 0.113, Kahn1 4B 0.064. Choice over every intent (77 / 60 options), 1,184 items: JEV 79.1%, Kahn1 4B 70.4%, Kahn1 3B 68.4%. An earlier comparison gave JEV every intent and Kahn1 only 8 options; it was unequal and has been corrected. On the 231 public JevBench items: Jev 86.6% (its published outcomes), JevK5 v0.2 86.1% (another open Qwen3.5-4B model, its own public run), Kahn1 4B 83.1%; hard tier 73.0%, 73.9% and 70.3%. Kahn1 4B vs JevK5 item by item: 11 vs 18 items only one gets right, exact McNemar p = 0.26, not significant. JEV median round trip 248 ms over the network; Kahn1 4B 87.5 ms and Kahn1 3B 36.4 ms on a local GPU.

Caveats: 4B and 3B models, not frontier models; JEV is more accurate on every held-out primitive; Score is the weakest primitive; computing dates, durations or amounts in a single forward pass is weak; on JevBench the 4B lost a little against the 3B on short intent classification; calibration was fitted on the training distribution and should be redone on your domain; confidence is the distance from a uniform guess, not the probability of being right. The browser demos run a 4-bit GGUF of the 3B v1 checkpoint.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://kahn1.com/): what Kahn1 is, use cases, caveats, benchmark results
- [Accueil (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/): la même page en français
- [Benchmarks](https://kahn1.com/benchmarks/): every result, Kahn1 vs JEV on the same items, latency, how to reproduce
- [Résultats (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/resultats/): les mêmes résultats en français
- [Models](https://kahn1.com/models/): Kahn1 4B and Kahn1 3B, merged models and LoRA adapters, sizes, licences, how to load them
- [Modèles (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/modeles/): la même page en français
- [Setup prompt for AI agents](https://kahn1.com/get-started/setup-prompt.md): paste into Claude Code or any coding agent to install and test Kahn1
- [Get started](https://kahn1.com/get-started/): install, serve, API, response format, calibration
- [Démarrer (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/demarrer/): le même guide en français
- [Playground](https://kahn1.com/playground/): ask typed questions about any text, model in the browser (WebGPU) or on your server
- [Kahn1 plays Snake](https://kahn1.com/snake/): one Choice question per tick, the move read from the logits
